description: olife_friends (16.10): `lab olife bundle` — the friend's zip (stock VoxelCore 0.32 exe + res, COPIES of olife_client/olife_proto, settings.toml, OLIFE.bat, ПРОЧТИ.txt) built into artifacts, unpacked into artifacts: no junctions/symlinks, no .bak/__pycache__/probes, the editor font olife_mono.ttf present, the exe = stock 0.32, the sha256 pack manifest of the unpacked copy == the server's distribution. Then the F2F 0.32 test build (never the stock exe of the zip) runs with --dir = the unpacked folder and the --script of OLIFE.bat against the public play stack (dry) -> the client menu opens -> login by the host's LAN address + #fingerprint and a whitelisted nick -> play -> back to the menu.
